title: Loner Life in Another World Season 2 Officially Announced
content: Loner Life in Another World Season 2 anime has been officially announced, with the show set to return after over two years. The first anime season aired in Fall 2024. The announcement was accompanied by a new “Season 2 Confirmed” visual, which you can see below.
author: Anime Corner

title: Light Novel 'S-Rank Boukensha de Aru Ore no Musume-tachi wa Juudo no Father-con Deshita' Gets TV Anime
content: Production company Overlap opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Kametsu Tomobashi 's S-Rank Boukensha de Aru Ore no Musume-tachi wa Juudo no Fathercon deshita ( My Daughters, S-Rank Adventurers, Have a Severe Father Complex ) light novel on Saturday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Lv2 kara Cheat datta Motoyuusha Kouho no Mattari Isekai Life' Gets Second Season
content: Production company Overlap announced a second season of the Lv2 kara Cheat datta Motoyuusha Kouho no Mattari Isekai Life ( Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers ) television anime on Saturday, revealing a commemorative visual (pictured) and the announcement promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers Season 2 Officially Announced
content: Chillin’ in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers officially announced a Season 2 anime, revealing a teaser visual and trailer. The first season aired for 12 episodes from April to June 2024. The teaser trailer looks back at memorable moments from Season 1, and you can check it out below.
author: Anime Corner

title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers Anime Reveals Cast, Staff, October Debut
content: Hakuhodo unveiled the cast, staff, and October television debut of the television anime of Isle Osaki 's Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers ( Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kōryaku or Clear the world like a game with the zero believers goddess ) light novel series on…

title: Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond Short Animated Film Revealed in Sneak Peek Video
content: Sega announced the Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond 35th anniversary short film on Saturday at Anime Expo 2026. The company revealed a sneak peek video of the film. The full short will debut this fall. Dr.
author: ANN

title: Overgeared Anime Reveals First Full Trailer, Key Visual, and Two New Cast Members Ahead of October Premiere
content: The upcoming Overgeared anime has revealed its first full trailer, a new key visual, and two additional cast members ahead of its October 2026 premiere. Crunchyroll previously confirmed that it would stream the anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized Releases Trailer
content: The upcoming Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized anime released a new trailer. The announcement was revealed at Crunchyroll’s anime showcase at Anime Expo 2026. Studio J.C. Staff is animating the series with Hideki Okamoto as director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Overgeared TV Anime Reveals More Cast in 1st Promo Video
content: The staff of Tempal: Item no Chikara (Tempal ~The Power of Items~), the television anime of South Korean webtoon studio REDICE STUDIO 's Overgeared webtoon, revealed the anime's first key visual, first promotional video, and more cast members on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: 'Tempal: Item no Chikara' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, First Promo
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase panel at Anime Expo 2026 revealed a pair of cast members, additional staff, key visual (pictured), and a promotional video for the Tempal: Item no Chikara ( Overgeared ) television anime on Friday. The anime adapting Saenal Park and Team Argo 's action fantasy webtoon begins in October 2026.
author: MyAnimeList
